plays.title: Ship Embeddable No-Backend Tools
plays.description: Launch tiny, instantly usable tools that require nothing from the user except a couple of links or a visit.
plays.action: 1. Pick a narrow, common need that can be solved with public data sources or pure frontend (e.g. turn Dropbox share links into a gallery). 2. Build a self-contained responsive HTML/CSS/JS solution with features like grids, lightbox, and captions. 3. Deploy to free static hosting such as Cloudflare Pages or Netlify. 4. Tweet the outcome first: benefit + constraints removed (Just add X — no hosting needed). 5. Mention it works as a standalone page or embeddable widget and link the live demo.

plays.title: Post Reusable CSS + JS Experiments
plays.description: Create and openly share small, delightful interactive frontend elements on CodePen so others can grab and reuse them.
plays.action: 1. Build a lightweight visual or interactive widget using only vanilla CSS + JS (e.g. animated googly eyes or hover effects). 2. Polish and publish a clean, forkable version on CodePen. 3. Tweet casually: describe what you built and where you used it. 4. Share the CodePen link and note that people can grab the code. 5. Tag any relevant accounts or platforms mentioned.

plays.title: Highlight Real Usage Metrics with Launches
plays.description: Use credible traction numbers (3K+ WAU etc) to prove that simple tools achieve real adoption when you ship or mention products.
plays.action: 1. Track meaningful metrics on your key micro-products. 2. When announcing a new tool or update, include a relevant usage figure if available. 3. Post clean milestone statements or screenshots tied directly to the ship. 4. Use the numbers to reinforce that keeping things simple drives adoption. 5. Keep bios and product pages updated with the latest credible stats.

plays.title: Submit to Platform Showcases & Themed Drops
plays.description: Gain distribution and social proof by submitting projects to official galleries and occasionally promoting builder-themed merch.
plays.action: 1. Watch for themed calls (Netlify HotAppSummer etc) and quickly build or adapt a fitting small project. 2. Submit to the official showcase or gallery. 3. Announce on X with 'I shipped [Name] for @[host] #[event]' and link straight to the showcase entry. 4. For merch, set up #vibecoding collections on Teemill and tweet free shipping events with the direct store link. 5. Keep posts short, visual, and benefit-focused.
